title: Fix Google Search Console HTML verification file accessibility at site root

requirements.text: Ensure the Google Search Console HTML verification file is publicly accessible at the exact site-root path `https://vsapplianceshub.in/googlea74065339385fd9b.html` and returns HTTP 200 with the file body containing `google-site-verification: googlea74065339385fd9b.html`.
acceptanceCriteria: A GET request to `https://vsapplianceshub.in/googlea74065339385fd9b.html` returns HTTP 200.
The response body contains the exact text `google-site-verification: googlea74065339385fd9b.html`.
The file is served as a static asset from the deployed frontend (not via a React route).

requirements.text: Make the verification file resilient to a trailing-slash request by serving equivalent verification content for `https://vsapplianceshub.in/googlea74065339385fd9b.html/` (as shown in the user’s Google Search Console flow), without breaking the non-trailing-slash URL.
acceptanceCriteria: A GET request to `https://vsapplianceshub.in/googlea74065339385fd9b.html/` returns HTTP 200 (not 404).
The trailing-slash response body contains `google-site-verification: googlea74065339385fd9b.html`.
The non-trailing-slash URL `https://vsapplianceshub.in/googlea74065339385fd9b.html` continues to work as before.

constraints: Do not modify any files under `frontend/src/components/ui` (read-only).
Do not edit files listed in `frontend.immutablePaths` in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
Keep all backend logic in the single Motoko actor (`backend/main.mo`); no backend changes are required for this fix unless static asset serving cannot be achieved otherwise.
nonGoals: Adding Google Search Console verification via HTML meta tag or DNS verification (only HTML file upload is in scope).
Changing sitemap.xml or robots.txt contents unless required to fix verification file accessibility.
Implementing additional SEO features beyond making the verification URL(s) accessible.
